meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: 装上后，各官署在关键操作节点把分发、扫描、解析、卡片生成等事件交给它记录，按 trace_id 串成可追溯证据链，并生成向量索引，支持按条件检索历史证据、做审计与回放。
howto.when: 在构建多智能体系统、需要全链路可观测与安全审计时使用；各官署在分发、扫描、解析等关键操作节点调用，或经事件总线异步推送事件时接管留痕。

say.text: 把这条事件写入证据链：actor、action、target、trace_id
查一下这个 trace_id 串起来的全部证据
say.note: 按 trace_id 检索历史证据

howto.what_en: Once installed, it records dispatch, scan, parse and card-generation events at key nodes, chains them by trace_id into a traceable evidence chain, and builds a vector index so history can be queried, audited and replayed.
howto.when_en: Use it when building multi-agent systems needing end-to-end observability and security audit; each agency calls it at key operation nodes or pushes events asynchronously over the event bus.

say_en.text: Write this event into the evidence chain: actor, action, target, trace_id
Show all evidence chained under this trace_id
Run the provenance stage and output trace.jsonl plus trace_summary.json
